title: upgrade-attn-flashattnv2-rope-rotary-fused-kv-batching-scheduling
author: Ava Chen
release_notes: Integrates FlashAttention v2 kernels with fused RoPE/rotary ops and contiguous KV cache layout. Improves p99 latency and throughput for long-context workloads; no API changes. Rollout gated by canary and performance smoke tests.
description: Motivation: reduce per-token cost and p99 latency for long-context models by integrating FlashAttention v2 kernels and a set of fused attention optimizations. Summary: upstream FlashAttention v2 integration, fused rotary/RoPE handling to avoid extra transposes, fused qkv projection path for common model layouts, contiguous KV cache layout to improve GPU memory access for continuous batching, and scheduler heuristics to prefer the new kernels for long sequences and large batch sizes. Includes microbenchmarks, upgraded QA, and a canary rollout plan. Checklist: [x] FlashAttention v2 integration and wrapper layer [x] fused ops for RoPE/rotary and qkv [x] contiguous KV cache implementation and migration shim [x] scheduler knob to select kernel variant based on seq_len and device memory pressure [x] unit & integration tests [x] perf benchmarks and canary job. Related tickets: ENG-4218 ENG-4221 SUP-887. No public API changes. Rollout: initial canary on Dedicated, monitor latency/cost dashboards, then global rollout with automatic fallback to previous kernels.
